introduction: This intermediate tier explores the internal structures of these bodies, the massive data systems they manage (like UDISE+), and how NEP 2020 proposes to restructure them to eliminate conflict of interest.

core_concepts.title: Constituent Units of NCERT
core_concepts.description:
NCERT operates through several specialized institutes:
1. RIEs (Regional Institutes of Education): Located in Ajmer, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Mysore, and Umiam (Shillong). They offer innovative integrated teacher education courses (like 4-year B.A.B.Ed.).
2. CIET (Central Institute of Educational Technology): Handles digital education, SWAYAM PRABHA, DIKSHA, and educational media.
3. PSSCIVE (Pandit Sunderlal Sharma Central Institute of Vocational Education): Based in Bhopal, it designs vocational curricula.

core_concepts.title: NIEPA and UDISE+
core_concepts.description:
Unified District Information System for Education (UDISE+). 
- Originally developed by NIEPA (now managed by MoE), UDISE+ is the largest educational management information system in India.
- Function: It collects real-time data from over 1.5 million schools regarding enrollment, infrastructure (toilets, electricity), and dropout rates. This data drives all national policy planning and funding allocations (like Samagra Shiksha).

core_concepts.title: NEP 2020: The Separation of Functions
core_concepts.description:
NEP 2020 identifies a major flaw in the current system: State education departments currently handle policy-making, regulation, and operations, creating a massive conflict of interest.
- Solution: NEP mandates a strict separation. The Department of School Education will only handle policy. An independent State School Standards Authority (SSSA) will handle regulation. The Directorate of Education (DoE) will handle operations.

core_concepts.title: The Restructuring of NCTE (PSSB)
core_concepts.description: Under NEP 2020, the Higher Education Commission of India (HECI) will be created as a single umbrella body. The current NCTE will be restructured into a Professional Standard Setting Body (PSSB) working under the General Education Council (GEC) to formulate the National Professional Standards for Teachers (NPST).

important_entities.name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
important_entities.significance: Introduced in 2018, it subsumed three previous schemes: SSA (Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan), RMSA (Rashtriya Madhyamik Shiksha Abhiyan), and TE (Teacher Education). It treats school education holistically, from pre-school to Class 12, heavily utilizing NCERT for pedagogy and NIEPA for planning.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Examiners often use fake acronyms. Remember that the body responsible for educational television and radio inside NCERT is the Central Institute of Educational Technology (**CIET**). Do not select options like 'Council of Information Tech'.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: B B A M M (Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Ajmer, Mysore, Meghalaya/Shillong)
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Use BBAMM to instantly recall the 5 cities that host Regional Institutes of Education (RIEs).

exam_strategy_tips: If a UGC NET question asks 'Which institute is responsible for creating and maintaining the data required to track the Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) of schools in India?', the answer is **NIEPA** (via the UDISE system).
